name: Runpod GPU Cloud pricing
notes: Page states 'Updated September 27, 2026'. Community Cloud Pods (per hour, dedicated instance): H200 $4.59, B300 $7.89, B200 $6.79, RTX Pro 6000 $2.09, H100 NVL $3.19, H100 PCIe $2.89, H100 SXM $3.49, A100 80GB $1.59, L40S $1.09, L40 $0.82, A40 $0.49, L4 $0.49, RTX 3090 $0.50, RTX 4090 $0.74. A separate Secure Cloud column exists but the extracted table shows one rate per SKU. Serverless (per worker-hour, not per GPU): H200 $5.93, H100 $4.79, A100 $2.72, B200 $8.64, L40S/A6000-class $1.75, 24GB $1.10, 16GB $0.58. Clusters: H200 SXM $4.31, A100 SXM $1.79, but H100 SXM / L40S / B200 are 'Contact sales'. Reserved Clusters are contact-sales for every GPU. Storage $0.05-0.14 per GB/month. So Runpod publishes straight per-hour numbers with no sales call, which makes it one of the best-sourced records in this slice.
